svg.title: Actual and predicted greenhouse climate targets
svg.desc: Two scatter plots compare actual and predicted 30-minute-ahead greenhouse temperature and humidity on 360 unseen readings. Dashed diagonal lines mark perfect predictions, and each panel reports its own mean absolute error and R squared.
